From Planet Waves · Price: it takes time to arrive, and longer indoors; it can't reach underground.

Theme Force and Energy

  • 1: 2 actions: call a meteorite on a 5-ft square within 60 ft; it lands at the start of your next turn: @Damage[(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[bludgeoning],(1+floor((@actor.level - 1)/4))d6[fire]] (@Check[reflex|against:stand|basic]{basic Reflex}). Indoors, it must punch through the roof or a wall first: it lands at the start of your turn after next, and its square or area becomes difficult terrain from the rubble. It can't reach underground.
  • 5: Surge: the meteor lands in a @Template[burst|distance:10]{10-ft burst} within 60 ft that spares creatures you choose: @Damage[(ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[bludgeoning],(ceil(@actor.level/2))d6[fire]]; @UUID[Compendium.pf2e.conditionitems.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{prone} on a critical failure.
  • 9: The meteor can follow a creature you marked (it lands on its new space).
  • 13: Burst 15 ft.
  • 17: Two meteors per surge; the second is a fragment that deals half the first's damage (both on one save).

Defaults: Stand, Occult and Concentrate traits; a surge costs 1 Stand Point and 2 actions unless listed; ranges are measured from your stand; untyped damage is force; saves use your stand DC. A minion an ability makes, unless it says otherwise, is a creature of your level – 2 built with GM Core's Low numbers (Building Creatures), with the minion trait.
